text:
marta: Quick sync — can folks post a one-line update for the Q2 milestone handoff by EOD? We need: shipped/slipped, owner, next immediate step, and any blockers. Focus: 'p99 latency -20%' OKR.

ajay: Shipped: KV-cache prefixing prototype merged to staging. Owner: ajay. Next: load test across larger seq lengths. Blocker: need Dedicated infra quota bump for 4x load. pinging @kevin. :eyes:

dana: Slipped: dynamic batching optimizer (was scoped for this milestone). Owner: dana. Next: re-scope to v1 w/ static heuristics, target reschedule to next sprint. Blocker: perf regressed ~3% on long-seq cases.

leo: Shipped: telemetry hooks for token-level latency + traces. Owner: leo. Next: wire into Console dashboard. Blocker: no, just a small UX mapping task.

olivia: Shipped: manifest of model variants + quantization configs for canary. Owner: olivia. Next: coordinate rollout policy with eng-sre. Blocker: need approval for fallback latency SLOs.

kevin: Re infra quota: approved burst for Dedicated pools (4 nodes) for 48h. I'll provision by EOD. @ajay please post expected qps so I can size.

ajay: thanks @kevin — aiming for 2k req/s sustained, burst 3.5k. I'll add numbers to the ticket.

dana: Re scoping: proposing we cut full optimizer and land smaller rule-based batching to hit latency target. Will create PR description and perf expectations.

marta: Thanks. One more ask — product needs an owner for cross-team validation (smoke evals + user-facing regressions). Any volunteers? Should be someone from applied ML or product.

leo: I can take validation owner for smoke eval harness. Will coordinate with @olivia for model variants.

marta: Perfect. Can you post a checklist when you open the validation task? Minimal items: sample prompt set, baseline p99, pass/fail thresholds, rollback criteria.

ci-bot: CI: nightly-build finished — 2 failing tests in infra-queue (investigating). See: https://ci.internal/r/1802501234

kevin: Noted on CI. I'll wait for the infra test fixes before spinning up the full 4-node burst. Keep me updated in this thread. :thumbsup:

marta: Summary for handoff (copying into the milestone doc):
- Shipped: KV-cache prefixing (ajay), telemetry hooks (leo), model manifests (olivia).
- Slipped: dynamic batching optimizer (dana) -> rescope to v1 heuristics.
- Owners: ajay (kv), dana (batching), leo (telemetry + validation), olivia (models), kevin (infra).
- Blockers: infra quota until CI fixes, perf regression on optimizer.
- Next steps: load tests + infra burst (ajay/kevin), scoped PR for batching (dana), validation checklist (leo).

marta: I'll mark this as the EOD status and update the OKR doc unless someone objects.

ajay: No objections. thanks all.

dana: Fine with that. I'll post the PR today.

leo: I'll open the validation task in ~30m with checklist.

olivia: All good from my side.

marta: Great — thanks team! :confetti_ball:
